annotations.title: Switch an automation on or off

description: Switch one automation on (status active) or off (paused), by its id from list_automations. OFF is never gated. ON goes through that engine's own gate: an ad rule that can raise spend needs confirm:true AND confirmScope (the scope token the refusal names) after the user agrees; a boost automation needs confirm:true after the user has seen its spend ceiling. Call once without confirm to get exactly what to show the user. The result is read back from the engine. Free.

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed to switching it on

confirmScope.description: for an ad rule that can raise spend: the scope token the first refusal names

id.description: the automation id from list_automations (meta_rule:…, google_rule:…, tiktok_rule:…, boost:…, alerts:…, dm:…, refill)

name: set_automation_status
